claims: Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026 for the film One Battle After Another.
The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
The 98th Academy Awards marked Paul Thomas Anderson's first Oscar win in Best Director category.
One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
Ryan Coogler was nominated for Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards for Sinners.
Chloé Zhao was nominated for Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards for Hamnet.
Josh Safdie was nominated for Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards for Marty Supreme.
Joachim Trier was nominated for Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards for Sentimental Value.
Paul Thomas Anderson secured top directing honors at the BAFTAs.
Paul Thomas Anderson secured top directing honors from the Directors Guild of America
